## Problem
What problem does this solve? Who hits it and how often?

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about and why this is better.

## Additional context
Mockups, links to similar features in other projects, etc.

## Are you willing to contribute?
- [ ] I can write the PR
- [ ] I can test
- [ ] I can document
- [ ] I'm only requesting (no time to contribute)
